046131201.accepts_evidence: The process starts with an eligibility quiz and a letter of inquiry, but the site warns it does not frequently fund unsolicited LOIs. https://www.fidelityfoundation.org/applying-and-reporting/letter-of-inquiry/

046131201.deadlines: not stated; the foundation replies within 60 days of an LOI
046131201.eligibility: Current 501(c)(3) public charity; operating budget of $1 million or more; proposed project budget of $100,000 or more
046131201.geographic_limits: Community projects near Fidelity Investments employee sites: Albuquerque NM; Boston MA; Raleigh/Durham NC; Covington KY/Cincinnati OH; Dallas/Fort Worth TX; Denver CO; Jacksonville FL; Jersey City NJ; Merrimack NH; Smithfield RI; Salt Lake City UT. Also organizations of national importance and high-impact projects that could inform the sector.
046131201.grant_range_stated: not stated (project budget must be at least $100,000)
046131201.how_to_apply: Take the online eligibility quiz, then submit a letter of inquiry for the one project that best fits. The foundation contacts the applicant if it wants a full proposal.
046131201.name: Fidelity Foundation
046131201.not_funded: Start-up, sectarian or civic organizations; disease-specific associations; individuals; operating support; sponsorships; galas or benefits; scholarships; corporate memberships; video or film projects; emergency funding; generally no successive-year or multi-year grants; capital campaigns that have not raised at least half their goal or where the foundation would be lead or majority donor
046131201.notes: Project-based capacity funder: capital, planning and technology only. Dallas/Fort Worth is a named site, which matters for Fort Worth-area applicants. The $1 million operating budget floor and $100,000 project floor screen out small organizations. Unsolicited LOIs are accepted but seldom funded, so a relationship route matters.
046131201.types_of_support: Capital (construction, renovation, expansion), planning initiatives (consultant-led strategic, business, feasibility or technology plans), and technology projects. No operating support.
